'''Vincent''' is an [[NPC]] in the {{zone|Artist's Abode}}. He serves as a guide to the [[Dye]] system, which was improved upon with his release.

== Mechanics ==
=== Dye Drop Chance Boost ===
On every [[Time Systems#SkyBlock_Time|SkyBlock Year]], 3 [[Dyes]] are randomly chosen by '''Vincent'''. Out of these, 2 have their drop chances {{Green|doubled}}, while the 3rd one has its drop chances {{Green|tripled}} during that year.

The current year's chosen Dyes can be seen in '''Vincent's''' interface.

=== Donating Dyes ===
A [[Player]] can donate any non-animated [[Dye]] via '''Vincent's''' menu, thus converting it into a [[Bucket of Dye]] accessory of a matching color.

=== Garden ===
'''Vincent''' can appear as a [[The Garden#Visitor|Visitor]] on {{zone|The Garden}} once the player reaches {{Garden|14}} and donated a [[Dye]] to '''Vincent'''. '''Vincent''' requests {{Item|Sunflower}}s and has a {{Chance|0.04%|1|2500}} to award a {{Item|Wild Strawberry Dye}}.

== Interface Bugs ==
*Opening the Dye Guide and sorting by Most Dropped will display the dyes in a seemingly random order. This is can be fixed by sorting the Dye Guide by Least Dropped and then going back to Most Dropped where it is then correctly displayed.

== Trivia ==
*He explicitly mentions {{NPCSprite|Marco}} and {{NPCSprite|Pablo}} implying their fame.
*''''Vincent''' is based on the 19th-century Dutch painter [[w:Vincent van Gogh|Vincent van Gogh]], who is renowned worldwide for his works.
**Similarly to his real life counterpart, '''Vincent''' is missing his left ear.
*'''Vincent''' was added to the [[SkyBlock Prototype|main server]] on the birthday of [[w:Andy Warhol|Andy Warhol]], another famous artist, known particularly for his pop art.
*'''Vincent''' asking for {{Item|Sunflower}} while visiting {{zone|The Garden}} is a reference to two series of still life paintings titled [[w:Sunflowers (Van Gogh series)|Sunflowers]].
*After giving '''Vincent''' a {{Item|Mole Pet}} for his [[Abiphone]] Contact, a {{Level|53}} {{Item|Mole Pet}} will be seen floating next to him.
**Although the maximum rarity of a pet is {{Mythic}}, the pet's text color matches {{aqua|Vincent}}, but it may imply it is somehow {{Divine}}.
**The level of '''Vincent's''' {{Level|53}} {{Item|Mole Pet}}, a reference to [[w:Vincent van Gogh|Vincent van Gogh]] being born in 1853.
*{{Gamemode|Ironman}} players can only donate dyes that they have obtained themselves, and not ones purchased from the [[Auction House]]. This is tracked on a per-item basis, regardless of whether they have already obtained another copy of the same dye themselves.
